subject: Hold demo until sample ingest & SSO entitlement complete
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenlane.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenlane Demo Team <sales@greenlane.io>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo next week?

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick response — we're excited to see Redwood in action. We have availability the week of Mar 15 and could do a 45-minute slot any day except Tuesday. We have a short agenda: metrics ingestion, prompt routing, and a brief SLA discussion.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Will you be able to show a sample ingest of our telemetry CSV (we can provide a redacted extract)?
- Can you confirm if SSO/entitlements will be available for an enterprise preview?

If you need extra time to prepare sample runs, we're flexible on dates.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Data Platforms
Greenlane Analytics
elena.torres@greenlane.io

Attachment: initial_scope.docx (document stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenlane.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo next week?

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually).

Quick context: I'm the solutions lead on this engagement and I'll be running the demo. We can absolutely demo ingestion and the routing rules you mentioned, but to make the session genuinely useful for your team we'll need two things completed beforehand:

1) A small sample dataset (redacted CSV) and a short workload trace so we can pre-provision right batching/quantization settings;
2) Temporary SSO entitlement + a service account with minimal read-only access so we can show the integration end-to-end.

Right now Dev (cc'd) is traveling Mar 15–18 for an on-site partner summit and will not be available for the technical dry-run to validate the sample ingest. Given he's the one who runs the sample ingest scripts and has the temporary infra keys, we recommend moving the public demo to the following week unless Greenlane prefers a high-level walkthrough without live ingest.

I'm attaching a 2-page prep runbook that lays out the exact files and creds we need, plus a CSV schema reference. If you can share the sample by Friday (Mar 12) we'll be able to get everything staged for a Mar 22 demo.

Proposed options: 
- Option A: Move demo to week of Mar 22 — full live ingest + SSO preview (recommended)
- Option B: Keep current slot for a high-level product walkthrough (no live ingest)

Let me know what you'd prefer and we can lock a time.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: prep_runbook_v1.pdf, sample_data_spec.csv

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenlane.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenlane Demo Team <sales@greenlane.io>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo next week?

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the practical options.

We'd prefer Option A (full live ingest). Dev being out makes total sense as a reason to shift. We'll plan to get the redacted CSV and a short trace over by Friday.

One question: our security/compliance reviewer will want confirmation you can support our SSO pattern with SCIM provisioning. Is that something Redwood can demo in a preview capacity? If not, we'll still proceed with ingestion and view SSO as a follow-up.

I'll confirm internally and reply by EOD Thursday.

Cheers,
Elena

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo next week?

Hi all — sorry for the travel overlap; I'm back today and have started staging the sample pipeline using the CSV Sofia attached. Two quick notes from the infra side:

- I completed an initial ingest dry-run against a local replica. Found two small column-name mismatches; I've included a sanitized pipeline log snippet below.
- We can demonstrate SCIM-style provisioning in the console as a read-through, but a production end-to-end with provisioning + SCIM provisioning sync requires a short entitlement enablement on your side (we'll need your IdP metadata). We can show the flow and the provisioning panel without wiring to your IdP if Greenlane prefers that for the Mar 22 slot.

Pipeline log (sanitized):
- 2027-03-22T07:03Z INFO parsed 1,200 rows
- WARN column "userEmail" vs expected "email" (mapped automatically)
- INFO KV cache warmed for recent tokens

If Elena confirms Mar 22, I'll schedule the technical dry-run for Mar 21 (30 minutes) to validate keys and final sample.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
SRE Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: sso_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenlane.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo next week?

Thanks everyone — locked in on our side for Mar 22 at 10:00 AM PT for the full demo with live ingest and SSO preview (non-production wiring). Elena — can you confirm you can share the redacted CSV and IdP metadata by EOD Tuesday (Mar 23)? Note: for the dry-run (Mar 21) we'll ask for a service account key with read-only access to the sample store so we can complete a final run.

Agenda for Mar 22 (45m):
- 10m: Executive overview + success criteria alignment (Sofia)
- 20m: Live ingestion + routing demo (Dev)
- 10m: SSO/entitlement preview & rollout plan (Sofia + Marissa)
- 5m: Next steps & action items

Action items: 
- Elena: share CSV + workload trace + IdP metadata (EOD Mar 23) [attachments accepted to drive link above]
- Dev: schedule 30m technical dry-run for Mar 21 and share calendar invite
- Sofia/Marissa: prepare tailored runbook notes for Greenlane environment

Looking forward to it.

Best,
